2026-07-10: CRITICAL #1 (note self-wipe): added a `notingSegmentId` pin, separate from the playback-driven `activeSegmentId`. Pin is set on textarea focus (or first keystroke as a fallback); while pinned, the sync-from-storage effect no longer overwrites `noteText` when the active segment changes underneath it. Save persists against the pinned segment, not whatever is active at save time. Pin releases on Save, on a new Cancel button, or on blur when the note is empty. The active-segment/'note for' label shows which segment is pinned. CRITICAL #2 (raw ids): added a required `groupNumberBySegmentId: Map<string, number>` prop (same derivation `FollowAlongPanel`/`useRenderGroups` already produce) and replaced every raw-id render ('Active Segment: {activeSegmentId}', 'Segment: {anno.segmentId}') with the human-readable render-group ordinal ('Active Segment: N' / 'Segment N'). Warning #10: replaced the inert empty-state copy ('No notes for this chapter yet.') with action-teaching copy ('Notes you leave while listening appear here. Click a line to jump there, then jot a note.').
